about: Uno writes down what's worth remembering as it goes, the way OpenClaw's memory is meant to work: facts, plans and decisions from the chat go in today's daily note (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md), which dreaming later folds into long-term memory. Small talk writes nothing.
